name: cm-failures
description: Family J (system failures at a grid of injection times: app stop, head-unit restart, frozen gap, blind camera, lost command, stuck set speed, cruise dropout, the worst command path) with the gated module and with plain cruise; mild plant; the driver sets the cruise 5 km/h above the speed at the start. Plus SC3's best for reference (standard engine: run sc3best-failures.json).
